description: Cross-isotope check REFUTES the block-trace magnitude Δ_λ=sgn·dim_q²: it matches the deuteron (~101%) by coincidence and blows up 40-450x for T/³He/⁴He. The DERIVED sign is validated cross-isotope (right sign all four). Binding magnitude returns to open; nothing wired.
tier: measurement (reuses atom-chi-rust χ + validated y_lambda_at; AME targets)

assertions.name: block_magnitude_blows_up_for_heavier
assertions.detail: T/³He/⁴He: dim_q² -> t:39.4, 3he:59.5, 4he:449.6 (40-450x overshoot) => block-trace magnitude REFUTED; deuteron match coincidental

assertions.name: derived_sign_right_all_isotopes
assertions.detail: all four B same sign as target<0 => derived sign (-1)^{n(λ)} is RIGHT cross-isotope (counit systematics had WRONG sign for all four)

result.verdict: REFUTED (block-trace magnitude), SIGN VALIDATED (cross-isotope): Δ_λ=sgn·dim_q² reproduces the deuteron (~1.01) only by COINCIDENCE — it blows up 40-450x for T/³He/⁴He (t:39x, 3he:60x, 4he:450x), growing ~unboundedly with A. So the block-trace magnitude (dim_q² or dim²) is NOT the binding magnitude; the #3558 'block is the direction / convention selects dim_q²' lead is OVERTURNED by this cross-check (the single-isotope caveat was right). WHAT SURVIVES: the DERIVED sign (-1)^{n(λ)} (#3542) gives the RIGHT sign for ALL FOUR isotopes (all ratios >0), where the counit had the wrong sign for all four — so the jet-order sign holds up cross-isotope; only the magnitude fails. The binding magnitude returns to OPEN; nothing wired.

context.overturns: the #3558 block-trace lead (dim_q² was a deuteron coincidence)
context.survives: the derived sign (-1)^{n(λ)} — right sign for all four isotopes (#3542)
context.open: the binding magnitude (block trace refuted) — DERIVE, do not fit; nothing wired
